about_the_game:
Project Zero immerses you in an adrenaline-fueled, fast-paced first-person shooter experience designed for up to 16 players per match.

KEY FEATURES

  • Six diverse game modes: Team Death Match, Free For All, Capture The Flag, Gun Game, Elimination, and Bomb Defusal.

  • Fluid, responsive controls and smooth movement mechanics.

  • Wide range of weapons for customized loadouts.

  • Solo or team-based gameplay.

  • AI opponents to play against when no online players available.

  • Training mode to test weapons and experiment with mechanics.

  • Interactive tutorial to learn the basic movement.

  • Six maps to explore and battle on.

Experience fluid, responsive controls and smooth movement mechanics that let you run, jump, walk and slide with ease. With a wide range of weapons to choose from, players can customize their loadouts to suit their individual playstyle and dominate the competition.

Whether you prefer to go solo or work with your team, Project Zero offers exciting and competitive gameplay that will keep you coming back for more. With ongoing updates and new content, there's always something new to discover in this first-person shooter.

Get ready for the ultimate test of skill and strategy in Project Zero, where every move counts and every shot can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Early Accees Notice

Project Zero is in Beta/Early Access stage. Some features might not work correctly, and this version of the game might be unstable at times.

name: Project Zero

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum System Requirements might change in the future
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600K / AMD R5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended System Requirements might change in the future

short_description: Immerse in Project Zero's fast-paced FPS action. Master movement, choose your weapons wisely and engage in six game modes.
